chunks: And Ibrahim ibn Muhammad al-Hamadani wrote to him (peace be upon him).

A deceased person bequeathed that income should flow to a man from what remains of his third, and did not order the enforcement of his third. Is it for the executor to suspend the deceased's third due to the flowing (of income)? So he (peace be upon him) wrote: 'Enforce his third and do not suspend it.'

key_terms.إِنْفَاذ: Enforcement or execution of the bequest/will.
key_terms.ثُلُث: One-third of the estate, the maximum portion that can be bequeathed to non-heirs.

ai.seo_question: How is the one-third bequest portion handled when income flows from the remaining two-thirds of an estate?
ai.summary: In this ruling from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies the execution of the *thuluth* (one-third bequest) when the testator specifies that the bequest is funded from the residual estate rather than a fixed sum. The Imam mandates the immediate enforcement of the one-third portion, rejecting the practice of suspending its distribution to allow for ongoing income flow to the beneficiary, thereby prioritizing the definitive settlement of the bequest over indefinite usufruct arrangements. This highlights the Shia juristic preference for finality in estate distribution unless the will explicitly stipulates otherwise.

en.hubeali: And Ibrahim Bin Muhammad Al-Hamdany wrote to him<sup>asws</sup>

, ‘A deceased bequeathed that there should flow (income) upon a man what remains from his third, and did not order with the enforcement of his third. It is for the executor that he dedicates a third of the deceased (legacy) for the cause of the flowing (of the income)?’ So he<sup>asws</sup> wrote: ‘Enforce his third and do not suspend’.
en.sarwar: ‘Abd al-Rahman ibn Muhammad al-Hamadaniy wrote to him (the Imam), ‘Alayhi al-Salam, the following: “‘A deceased person has made a will which says that to so and so man an amount must be given continuously of what is left of the one-third of his legacy but has not said to complete the one-third. Is it necessary for the executor of the will to make the one-third an endowment to continue executing the will?’ He (the Imam), ‘Alayhi al-Salam, wrote, ‘The one-third must be spent and it must not be made an endowment.’”
